title: Stargate staff came from Sidney Gottlieb's Technical Services Staff

tellings.quote: know that actually a lot of original people who were on that program came from Sydney Gotaut's technical staff services.

plain: Many of the first people on Stargate, a US government programme of the 1970s to 90s that studied remote viewing (the claimed ability to describe distant places with the mind), are said to have come from the CIA's Technical Services Staff run by Sidney Gottlieb. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, while talking with a philosopher named Jason Jorjani. If true, it would tie the psychic research to the CIA's older work on the mind.
